title: 3277. Maximum XOR Score Subarray Queries

examples.explanation: In the first query, nums[0..2] has 6 subarrays [2], [8], [4], [2, 8], [8, 4], and [2, 8, 4] each with a respective XOR score of 2, 8, 4, 10, 12, and 6. The answer for the query is 12, the largest of all XOR scores. In the second query, the subarray of nums[1..4] with the largest XOR score is nums[1..4] with a score of 60. In the third query, the subarray of nums[0..5] with the largest XOR score is nums[1..4] with a score of 60.
